t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Yang witniisa O God man yangra paskatama kaikaia bara man mayunia. Yang nan witniisa naha pyua sip apia kapri bara man karnikamra; yang umpira lakasna bara man ailalka. Bahara God apusa bamansma. Help Patra, ba mita witin Self ra Baysa sma.
